people.name: Alfonso Quiñónez Molina
people.nameZh: 阿方索·基尼奧內斯·莫利納

body.zh-Hant: 據 Grieb 署名的百科條目，基尼奧內斯·莫利納（1873–1950）曾三度擔任薩爾瓦多總統（1914–1915、1918–1919、1923–1927）。他屬於控制總統職位的基尼奧內斯—梅倫德斯家族王朝，這些家族以操縱選舉維持政府控制，直到1931年大蕭條後軍方接管。
body.en: According to the signed entry by Kenneth J. Grieb, Quiñones Molina (1873–1950) was president of El Salvador three times (1914–1915, 1918–1919 and 1923–1927). He belonged to the Quiñones-Meléndez family dynasty that controlled the presidency; these families used rigged elections to keep control until the Great Depression brought military control in 1931.

citations.quote: Alfonso Quiñones Molina ( b. 1873; d. 1950)
president of El Salvador (1914–1915, 1918–1919, and 1923–1927)
belonged to the Quiñones-Meléndez Family dynasty that controlled the presidency
used rigged elections to maintain governmental control from the 1890s
until the Great Depression brought military control in 1931

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱他1914年短暫執政，當時的選舉讓其姻兄弟卡洛斯·梅倫德斯上台；1918年他組織首個正式政黨紅色聯盟（Liga Roja）後，再度掌權並過渡到1919年起由豪爾赫·梅倫德斯任總統；1923年他以自身名義成為總統，任至1927年。
body.en: The entry says he governed briefly in 1914 during the election that installed his brother-in-law Carlos Meléndez. After organizing the first official party, the Liga Roja (Red League), in 1918, he again held office during a transition that allowed Jorge Meléndez to be elected (president 1919–1923). He became president in his own right in 1923, serving until 1927.

citations.quote: He governed briefly in 1914 during the election that installed his
brother-in-law, Carlos Meléndez
After organizing the first official party, the Liga Roja (Red League) in 1918
he again held office during a transition that allowed the election of
Jorge Meléndez (president 1919–1923)
became president in his own right in 1923, serving until 1927.

body.zh-Hant: 條目寫到，他為取得聖薩爾瓦多鋪路經費而舉借的外債引起爭議，使民眾拒絕外債，這種情緒後來被歷屆軍人政權（特別是埃爾南德斯·馬丁內斯將軍的政權）利用。條目並指出，這個時期沒有詳細的研究專著。
body.en: The entry reports that his controversial foreign borrowing to secure funds for street paving in San Salvador caused the populace to reject external debt, a situation exploited by later military regimes, particularly that of General Maximiliano Hernández Martínez. It adds that there are no detailed studies of this era.

citations.quote: His controversial foreign borrowing to secure funds for street paving
caused a rejection of external debt by the populace
a situation that was exploited by later military regimes,
particularly that of General Maximiliano Hernández Martínez

body.zh-Hant: 據立陶宛議會傳記，米羅納斯1880年6月22日生於庫奧迪什基農場的農民家庭；1897至1901年在維爾紐斯神學院就讀，1904年畢業於聖彼得堡神學院並受任為神父。
body.en: According to the Seimas biography, Mironas was born on 22 June 1880 at the Kuodiškiai farmstead into a peasant family. He studied at the Vilnius seminary in 1897–1901, graduated from the Saint Petersburg ecclesiastical academy in 1904 and was ordained a priest that year.

heading.zh-Hant: 大維爾紐斯會議與立陶宛國家委員會
heading.en: Great Vilnius Seimas and the Council of Lithuania

body.zh-Hant: 傳記記載他1905年12月4至5日是大維爾紐斯會議成員；1917年立陶宛會議中選入立陶宛國家委員會，自1917年9月24日至1918年2月15日任第二副主席，1918年2月16日簽署立陶宛獨立法案。
body.en: The biography records that he was a member of the Great Vilnius Seimas on 4–5 December 1905. He was elected to the Council of Lithuania at the 1917 Lithuanian Conference and served as its second vice-chairman from 24 September 1917 to 15 February 1918; on 16 February 1918 he signed the Act of Independence of Lithuania.

body.zh-Hant: 他在馬里扎姆波列選區依立陶宛民族主義者聯盟名單當選第三屆議會議員，任期自1926年6月2日至1927年4月12日，屬民族主義者黨團。
body.en: He was elected to the Third Seimas in the Marijampolė constituency on the list of the Lithuanian Nationalist Union and was a member from 2 June 1926 to 12 April 1927, belonging to the nationalist faction.

heading.zh-Hant: 軍隊總隨軍神父與總理任期

body.zh-Hant: 傳記載明，他自1929年5月1日起擔任立陶宛軍隊總隨軍神父，至1938年3月24日止；1938年3月24日起任第十八屆總理，並於同年10月1日起任農業部長；1938年12月5日起任第十九屆總理，至1939年3月29日。
body.en: The biography states that from 1 May 1929 until 24 March 1938 he was chief chaplain of the Lithuanian army. He was prime minister of the XVIII cabinet from 24 March to 5 December 1938, became minister of agriculture on 1 October 1938, and was prime minister of the XIX cabinet from 5 December 1938 to 29 March 1939.

heading.zh-Hant: 蘇聯占領後的被捕與死亡

body.zh-Hant: 傳記記載，1940年9月12日他被蘇聯鎮壓機構逮捕；1941年6月23日起義者將他從監獄釋放；1947年8月23日被判七年徒刑，此後關押於弗拉基米爾監獄，1953年2月18日死於該處。
body.en: The biography records that on 12 September 1940 he was arrested by Soviet repressive structures and that insurgents freed him from prison on 23 June 1941. On 23 August 1947 he was sentenced to seven years in prison and he died in Vladimir prison on 18 February 1953.

body.en: According to the Armenian diplomatic-representatives directory, Vratsian (1882–1969) was born in the village of Metz Sala and studied at the Gevorgian Seminary in Etchmiadzin and at the University of Saint Petersburg. In 1910–1911 he edited the newspaper Harach in Karin and taught at schools there.

body.en: The directory records that in 1911–1914 he edited the newspaper Hayrenik in Boston. In 1914 he came to Tiflis and worked on forming Armenian volunteer regiments. After the February Revolution of 1917 he edited Horizon in Tiflis and was elected to the National Council and then to the Transcaucasian Seim.

body.zh-Hant: 名錄載明，1919年他任議會議員；1920年5月起任農業與勞動部長；1920年11月23日起任總理，兼任內政部長與外交部長；1920年12月2日他的政府因與俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國簽署協議而辭職；1921年二月起義期間，他當選祖國救亡委員會主席。
body.en: The directory states that in 1919 he was a member of parliament; from May 1920 he was minister of agriculture and labour; from 23 November 1920 he was prime minister, also serving as minister of internal affairs and minister of foreign affairs. On 2 December 1920 his government resigned after an agreement with the Russian SFSR, and during the February 1921 uprising he was elected chairman of the Committee for the Salvation of the Fatherland.

heading.en: The 1911 revolution and the Ministry of Justice

body.zh-Hant: 條目寫到，1911年11月3日他召集緊急會議，成立上海革命政府；他也成為武昌中央共和政府駐上海的外交部長與外交代表，並被指定為首席談判代表；1912年1月共和國成立後，他出任司法總長。
body.en: The entry says that on 3 November 1911 he convened the emergency meeting that established the Shanghai revolutionary government. He also became foreign minister and diplomatic representative in Shanghai of the central republican government at Wuhan and was designated chief delegate to negotiate a settlement. With the establishment of the republic in January 1912 he became minister of justice.

body.en: The entry says Wu accepted the foreign ministership in Tuan Ch'i-jui's cabinet in November 1916. President Li Yuanhung dismissed Tuan and named Wu acting premier on 23 May (1917); five days later Li Ching-hsi became premier. On 9 July Feng Kuo-chang dismissed Wu from the foreign ministership.

heading.en: Taking power in 1940 and the Iron Guard

body.zh-Hant: 條目載明，1940年9月4日他出任總理並握有獨裁權力；兩天後他迫使卡羅爾二世退位，與鐵衛團共組政府，自稱羅馬尼亞的「領袖」（conducator）；1941年1月21至22日鐵衛團藉叛亂製造屠殺猶太人事件。
body.en: The entry states that on 4 September 1940 he became prime minister with dictatorial powers. heading.zh-Hant: 對蘇戰爭、猶太人政策與處決
heading.en: The war on Russia, policy toward Jews, and execution

body.zh-Hant: 條目稱，1941年6月22日羅馬尼亞對俄作戰後，安東內斯庫下令進行敖德薩大屠殺（1941年11月23日）；1942年秋猶太領袖與外交使節施壓，阻止了將全國猶太人驅逐至集中營；他其後尋求單獨媾和，1946年6月6日被處決。
body.en: The entry says that after Romania entered the war against Russia on 22 June 1941, Antonescu ordered the Odessa massacre (23 November 1941). In autumn 1942 pressure from Jewish leaders and diplomats helped prevent the deportation of the entire Jewish population of Romania to concentration camps. He later began negotiating a separate peace and was executed on 6 June 1946.
